note: Jev-class decision models released after the pinned JevBench roster. Vendor-documented, unranked until JevBench measures them. `s1bench` is the macro accuracy S1Bench (bench.jakecuth.com, same six public suites as Jev 1.13.0, Jev = 0.775) reported on the review date; it is a third-party read, not a JevBench rank.
